causes_of_EPERM: the direct child after its exit and before the supervisor's next poll (brief)
an orphaned descendant after its exit and before launchd reaps it (brief; 1.5 to 1.8 ms observed)

a member whose parent never reaps it: a descendant moves itself into its own process group and never reaps its exited child, which stays in the owned group; lasts while that parent lives; needs no privilege (review D4)
a genuine permission refusal: a member this process may not signal
finding.effect_on_revision_3: the imported group_exists treats only ESRCH as an answer, so EPERM escapes as PermissionError in terminate_group's polling, in its three killpg signal sends (which catch only ProcessLookupError) and in run_process's group check after exit; the caller receives PermissionError instead of the original Stop, no cleanup receipt is recorded, and after a timeout or cancellation the direct child can stay unreaped

decision.rule: the group counts as absent only when the probe reports ESRCH; EPERM counts as present; a send refused with EPERM is passed over and never taken as proof of absence

sites: run_process: the precondition block; the original's three statements `libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)`, `if libc.prctl(36, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:` and `raise Stop("OTRAY-E-BACKEND", "Cannot establish Linux descendant reaping")` are replaced by statements that evaluate the Darwin precondition of contract section 5 and raise Stop("OTRAY-E-BACKEND", ...) when it is unmet
group_exists: the clause `except PermissionError:` / `return True` inserted immediately before `except ProcessLookupError:`
terminate_group, the SIGTERM send: `except ProcessLookupError:` becomes `except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):`
terminate_group, the SIGKILL send after the grace period: the same change
terminate_group, the final SIGKILL send before the ceiling Stop: the same change
allowed_differences.nothing_else: no other token differs, docstrings and comments included

decision.fail_closed: a group that keeps answering EPERM fails at the cleanup ceiling with the original Stop('OTRAY-E-BACKEND', 'Owned process group cleanup exceeded stage or transaction ceiling'), receipt cleanup {passed: false, reason}; this Stop replaces an earlier message of the same run; the recorded reason does not distinguish a never-reaped member, a permission refusal or a slow reaping; a descendant that moved itself out of the group survives, within 'no enforcement against descendants'
